description: Run the same page headless on two three.js releases (the installed one and `with`: r186, 0.186.1, next, previous, latest, or a folder with a three package; a release from npm is fetched once into $THREESMITH_HOME/three, nothing in node_modules changes) with the deterministic clock, and compare by meaning: new and gone console errors and warnings, objects lost, hidden or resized in the scene graph, renderer.info (calls, triangles, programs, textures), and the pixels with the mean luminance per object box on screen. Each change is annotated with the migration entry of the releases in between that explains it ("expected: r188 AmbientLight ... specular"), the ones this code uses first; a change no entry explains is flagged as a probable regression. With `bisect` ("r160..r188", or a comma list of releases or folders) it halves over the releases, one per release number, to the first one where the page changes against the first release (until: break counts only new errors and lost objects; `expect` claims as in three_play make it the first release where a claim fails), and explains that release's difference. Works when the page loads three through an import map, node_modules/three, a CDN three@x URL or a copied build file (not a bundled build).

base.description: the release of the first run (default installed)

bisect.description: a range, r160..r188, or a comma list of releases or folders: the first release where the page changes, breaks, or a claim fails

expect.description: with bisect: claims as in three_play ("window.x === 1 @ end"); bad = a claim fails

fixed_dt.description: deterministic clock: ms per frame (default 16.67); waits become frames

root.description: folder to serve when the page needs files above its own folder

seed.description: deterministic clock: seed for Math.random; the clock is paused and moves one fixed frame at a time, so every run gives the same frames and pixels

target.description: Folder with the page (index.html), or the http(s) URL of a running dev server.

tolerance.description: share of changed pixels that counts as a change (default 0.005)

until.description: with bisect: what counts as bad without expect (default change)

wait.description: ms (frames under the clock) before the capture, default 1500

with.description: the release to compare with: r186, 0.186.1, next, previous, latest, or a folder with a three package (needed without bisect)

name: three_compare
title: Run the page on two three.js releases and compare
